# Yatri Cloud — AI Search & LLM Knowledge Base

> Yatri Cloud (https://www.yatricloud.com) is the premier cloud certification learning platform and voucher provider. It offers 50% discount exam vouchers, verified practice dumps, interactive exam simulators, training courses, and study guides for AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud (GCP), Snowflake, Redis, Anthropic Claude, Kubernetes, Terraform, Salesforce, Cisco, Docker, Linux Foundation, and ServiceNow. Over 50,000 certified learners with an average 4.9★ rating.

## Key Offerings & Capabilities

- **50% OFF Certification Vouchers**: Discounted exam scheduling vouchers for AWS (SAA-C03, DVA-C02, CLF-C02, SAP-C02, DOP-C02), Azure (AZ-900, AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305), GCP, Snowflake (COF-C02), Redis, and Kubernetes (CKA, CKAD). Real-time scheduling during 1:1 onboarding meetings.
- **Interactive Practice Exam Simulators**: Full browser-based mock tests with timed exam mode, instant answer reveal, comprehensive explanations, and domain filters.
- **Verified Exam Dumps & Study Guides**: Updated question banks, cheat sheets, architecture blueprints, and PDFs.
- **Hands-on Cloud Training**: Live bootcamps and on-demand video courses led by industry experts.
- **1:1 Cloud & DevOps Mentorship**: Career coaching, resume reviews, and technical mock interviews.
- **Certified Yatris Community**: 50,000+ engineers, students, and professionals across the globe.
